title: B1 Mixed Review
description: Review por/para, relative pronouns, subjunctive triggers, and practical translations.

questions.explanation: Use 'por' with the article: 'pela ajuda' means 'for the help'.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct relative pronoun: 'A mulher ___ trabalha aqui é médica.'
questions.explanation: 'Que' can refer to a person as the subject of the relative clause.

questions.prompt: Complete: Tomara que ele ___ a tempo. (chegar)
questions.explanation: 'Tomara que' expresses a wish and takes the subjunctive.

options: I don't know where he lives.
I don't know when he lives.
I don't know why he left.
I don't know where he worked.
questions.answer: I don't know where he lives.

questions.prompt: Which command is polite and correct?
questions.explanation: 'Assine' is the standard polite command with 'você'.
